en.topic_title: China says opposes US sanctions bill targeting Russia energy buyers

zh.topic_title: China says opposes US sanctions bill targeting Russia energy buyers

en.topic_title: China says opposes US sanctions bill targeting Russia energy buyers
en.topic_summary:
China said on Wednesday it “firmly opposes” a sanctions bill proposed by US senators and supported by President Donald Trump that targets countries buying Russian energy.



Chinese and Russian flags. File photo: Wikimedia Commons.



The bipartisan legislation could potentially clear the way for the United States to exert stronger pressure on Russia over its war in Ukraine.



US senators spearheading the bill said in a joint statement last week that they expected to unveil the upda
